basics.name: Justin Jasper
basics.label: Computational Biologist, AI Researcher & Founder
basics.summary: Deeply passionate about applying AI to solve structural problems in healthcare — particularly how machine learning can make the full complexity of patient data accessible and actionable at the point of care.

work.name: Hong Kong, China
work.position: Biomedical AI Intern - Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics
highlights: Developed and deployed a novel full-stack landmark detection model for cardiac ultrasound images to assist non-specialist physicians in accurate diagnosis (Pytorch, Python, React, PostgreSQL).
Collaborated with the Emergency Department at Prince of Wales Hospital to test the cardiac ultrasound model and integrate it into clinical workflows for point-of-care ultrasound

Designed a hallucination-resistant LLM architecture leveraging biomedical knowledge graphs to support clinical decision-making and treatment plan formulation based on patient medical history and clinical data (Python, Neo4j)

work.name: Mclean, Virginia
highlights: Developed an LLM-driven retrieval augmented generation system to extract and summarize key insights from complex scientific literature, streamlining knowledge access for synthetic biology workflows (Used scientific python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Kubernetes).
Constructed the BioNet Domain-Specific Language, an open-source programming language designed to enable extensive scaling of synthetic biology experiments and industrial workflows.

work.name: Palo Alto, California
highlights: Led the development of a virtual try-on platform for e-commerce powered by computer vision and generative AI.
Participated in Launchpad (Stanford’s premier graduate accelerator) Spring ‘23 and Entrepreneur First’s NYC unicorn training program.
Piloted the tech with Abercrombie & Fitch, Revolve, and Everlane, where we showcased an average return rate reduction of over 50%.

projects.name: CV Image Processing for CT and Ultrasound-based Tumor Detection
highlights: Built a Python/OpenCV pipeline to segment and reconstruct 3D lung CT scans for cancer diagnosis, training an Attention U-Net (TensorFlow) for malignant/benign classification and applying K-means clustering to segment pulmonary abnormalities.

projects.name: Computer Vision for Meal Nutritional Analysis
highlights: Built a full-stack web app (Flask + HTML) for real-time food nutritional analysis from user-uploaded images, powered by a ResNet18 CNN with an object detection pipeline for food localization and classification.

projects.name: Computational Analysis of NMDA Receptor Antagonist Binding for Chronic Pain Therapeutics
highlights: Used SwissDock and AutoDock Vina to model NMDA receptor antagonist binding interactions, optimizing docking workflows and quantifying binding affinities to evaluate drug repurposing candidates for chronic pain.

projects.name: Python-Based Probabilistic Modeling of Biological Systems
highlights: Built Python computational models simulating molecular systems — including ion channel activation, protein-ligand binding, and polymer conformations — using Boltzmann statistical mechanics to predict multi-state behaviors and system energetics.

projects.name: Custom Heap Allocator (Memory Management & Systems Programming)
highlights: Designed and implemented a custom heap allocator in C, featuring both implicit and explicit free lists for dynamic memory allocation.
Optimized memory utilization and allocation efficiency by integrating block coalescing, splitting, and best-fit/free-list strategies.
Implemented a custom malloc, free, realloc, and calloc, improving memory allocation speed and fragmentation handling.

projects.name: Synthetic Biosensor Development for Pathogen Detection
highlights: Engineered a novel Salmonella biosensor using a SynNotch receptor system with an anti-Salmonella scFv transfected into HEK293 cells, validated via flow cytometry, Western blotting, PCR, and gel electrophoresis.
